ⓘ The Key — what it all means

New here? This is your decoder ring. Every emoji, color, and symbol on the list is explained below — so you always know what we’re telling you about a player.

👆 Tip: Click any player’s name to open their Deep Cut page — full stats, game log, and notes.

Player Tags (the emoji)

👀Must Watch drop everything, read his notes first. His name also shows in red.
🚨Alert, Add Now stop what you are doing and put in the claim.
🔥Hot Streak cooking the last 7 to 14 days. Ride it.
🫡Next Man Up the starter went down, he got the call.
⏳Short-term Answer plugs the hole this week. Not a long-term keeper.
🤕Injury Prone talented, but the body keeps interrupting.
😕Likely Owned likely already rostered in your league, still worth watching.
🧯Current Closer he has the ninth right now. Saves live here.
🛟Saves Speculation might get the ninth. Stash him cheap.
💫Injury Return Soon rehab clock is ticking. Grab him before he is activated.
🏟️Great Home Park the ballpark works for him. Numbers play up at home.
💥Power Bat home runs and RBIs are his game.
💨Steals Specialist speed and stolen bases are his bread and butter.
🤝Sell High public has him too high. Trade before the regression.
🚀Buy Low cheap right now. Not for much longer.
👶Rookie first-year player. Worth knowing before everyone else does.
🆙Recent Call-up just got the call. Story is being written.
🪖Platoon Hitter plays one side of the matchup. Check the pitcher’s hand.
🧀Premium Velo throws cheese. Elite velocity.
⚔️Filthy Stuff wipeout secondaries. Hitters are swinging at ghosts.
✌️Two Start Week two starts this week. Double the counting stats.
📅Good Upcoming Schedule soft matchups ahead. The streaming window is open.

The +/− Column

🆕 NEWNew — just added to the list.
+5Moved up — climbed 5 spots since our last update.
−3Moved down — dropped 3 spots since our last update.
—No change — held his spot.

Priority (the stars)

★★★★★How hard we’re pounding the table. More gold stars = higher priority. Half-stars count.

Stat Colors & Italics

.312Green/red numbers are hitter stats.
2.84Blue numbers are pitcher stats.
.298Italic numbers come from the minor leagues, not the majors yet.

The Advanced (Statcast) Columns

These are the “why” behind the numbers — what the ball and the swing actually did, straight from MLB’s tracking cameras.

xBAExpected batting average — what he should be hitting based on contact quality.
xERAExpected ERA — what a pitcher should have allowed.
xwOBAExpected overall offensive value — the best one-number bat (or pitcher-against) gauge.
Brl%Barrel rate — how often he makes the perfect, do-the-most-damage contact.
FB VeloFastball velocity — how hard a pitcher throws.
EVExit velocity — how hard he hits the ball, on average.
Bat SpdBat speed — how fast he swings.
SprintSprint speed — his raw foot speed.
K%Strikeout rate (lower is better for a hitter).
BB%Walk rate (higher is better for a hitter).
K-BB%Strikeouts minus walks — a pitcher’s command in one number (higher is better).
Chase%How often a hitter swings at pitches out of the zone (lower is better).
Whiff%How often a swing misses (for a pitcher, higher is better).
GB%Ground-ball rate — how often contact stays on the ground.

Each list serves a different fantasy format. Switch between them with the gold dropdown in the toolbar.

🏷️ Create a Tier

Draws a colored bracket around a contiguous range of players on the current list. Brackets hide automatically when the list is filtered or sorted, and reappear when the list returns to its default rank order. Each list keeps its own tiers.

➕ Add Custom Player

For players who aren't in the MLB or Yahoo data feeds yet (just-called-up rookies, etc.). Stats columns will show — until the APIs start tracking the player. The player will be added to the bottom of the active list.
